entities.name: Baltrice
entities.description: A red-aligned planeswalker and pyromancer, loyal lieutenant of Tezzeret in the Infinite Consortium.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: An artificer and planeswalker who leads the Infinite Consortium.

entities.name: Infinite Consortium
entities.description: The organization Baltrice and Tezzeret work for.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage scouted by the Consortium, disliked and later tortured by Baltrice.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker who defeated Baltrice during the fall of the Consortium.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: Plane where Jace saved Baltrice's life.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: Plane where Baltrice and Jace tried to capture Tezzeret.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane Baltrice tried to return to after her defeat.

entities.name: Fall of the Infinite Consortium
entities.description: The collapse of the Consortium, during which Jace escaped and Baltrice was defeated.

events.summary: Baltrice takes an intense dislike to Jace after he is scouted by the Consortium.
events.quote: Baltrice took an instant and intense dislike to the mind mage

events.summary: Baltrice lets Jace escape in return for him having saved her life on Kamigawa.
events.quote: She briefly showed her good side when she let Jace escape

events.summary: Baltrice repeatedly tortures Jace while he is imprisoned in Tezzeret's sanctum.
events.quote: she repeatedly tortured Jace while he was imprisoned in Tezzeret's sanctum

events.summary: During the fall of the Consortium Jace escapes and Baltrice is defeated by Liliana Vess.
events.quote: Jace escaped, and Baltrice was defeated by Liliana Vess

events.summary: Jace finds Baltrice trying to return to Ravnica and nurses her back to health; she works for him out of gratitude.
events.quote: Jace nursed her back to health

events.summary: Baltrice and Jace travel to Esper to capture Tezzeret.
events.quote: She turned up in Esper along with Jace

events.summary: The attempt fails and Jace is afflicted with an etherium device that blocks his powers.
events.quote: Jace is afflicted with an etherium device which prevents him from using magic

events.summary: Tezzeret agrees to remove the device if Baltrice helps him search for Crucius the Mad.
events.quote: Tezzeret agrees to remove the device if Baltrice helps him

events.summary: Baltrice assists Tezzeret in his fight at the Crystal Labyrinth.
events.quote: Baltrice assists Tezzeret in his fight

events.summary: Tezzeret offers Baltrice a sangrite necklace; Jace warns her it is a trick.
events.quote: Jace warns Baltrice not to put the necklace on

events.summary: Unsure who is telling the truth, Baltrice leaves both without wearing the necklace.
events.quote: Baltrice leaves Jace and Tezzeret without putting on the necklace

relations.quote: She is the loyal lieutenant of the artificer
Baltrice was defeated by Liliana Vess

relations.note: worked for him out of gratitude
relations.quote: working for Jace out of gratitude
